subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: In a right-angled triangle with hypotenuse c and other two sides a and b, Pythagoras' theorem states that:
questions.explain: The square on the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares on the other two sides.

questions.q: A right-angled triangle has the two shorter sides 5 cm and 12 cm. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
A 5 m ladder leans against a vertical wall with its base 3 m from the wall. How high up the wall does the ladder reach?
In a right-angled triangle, the sine of an angle is defined as:
questions.explain: From SOH: sin = opposite/hypotenuse.

questions.q: In a right-angled triangle, the tangent of an angle is equal to:
questions.explain: From TOA: tan = opposite/adjacent.

questions.q: To find an unknown angle when the opposite side and the hypotenuse are known, which operation is used?
questions.explain: Opposite over hypotenuse is the sine ratio, so the inverse sine gives the angle.

questions.q: A right-angled triangle has a hypotenuse of 10 cm and one angle of 60°. What is the length of the side adjacent to the 60° angle?
questions.explain: Adjacent = 10 × cos 60° = 10 × 0.5 = 5 cm.

questions.q: The angle of elevation of an object is measured:
options: upwards from the horizontal to the line of sight
downwards from the horizontal to the line of sight
from the vertical to the line of sight
between the two sides of the object
questions.explain: An angle of elevation is measured upward from the horizontal to the line of sight.

questions.q: What is the exact value of sin 30°?
questions.explain: sin 30° is exactly 1/2.

questions.q: What is the exact value of cos 60°?
questions.explain: cos 60° equals 1/2, matching sin 30° since the angles are complementary.

questions.q: What is the exact value of tan 45°?
questions.explain: tan 45° = 1 because the opposite and adjacent sides are equal.

questions.q: What is the exact value of tan 60°?
What is the exact value of cos 30°?
questions.explain: cos 30° equals √3/2.

questions.q: The graph of y = sin x repeats itself every:
questions.explain: The sine function has a period of 360°.

questions.q: For 0° ≤ x ≤ 360°, one solution of sin x = 0.5 is x = 30°. What is the other solution?
questions.explain: Sine is also positive in the second quadrant, so x = 180° - 30° = 150°.

questions.q: A triangle has sides a = 5 cm and b = 7 cm with an included angle C = 60°. Using the cosine rule, what is the length of side c (to 2 d.p.)?
What is the value of cos x when x = 0°?
questions.explain: The cosine graph starts at its maximum value of 1 when x = 0°.

questions.q: Which of the following correctly states the sine rule for a triangle with sides a, b, c opposite angles A, B, C?
options: a/sin A = b/sin B = c/sin C
a/cos A = b/cos B = c/cos C
questions.explain: The sine rule relates each side to the sine of its opposite angle.

questions.q: Which formula gives the area of a triangle when two sides a and b and the included angle C are known?
questions.explain: The area of a triangle with two sides and the included angle is ½ ab sin C.

questions.q: A triangle has two sides of 6 cm and 8 cm with an included angle of 30°. What is its area?
